method: Fresh dedicated staging Carriers document reload; identical temporary fetch and DOM observer; six read-only flows repeated three times, plus final warm Leads return. First suite visit N=1 per flow is not proof of cold HTTP or AWS caches; repeated returns N=2 per flow remain separate. Observer waits 750ms GraphQL quiet and bounds each flow to20s. No credential or response-body retention.
export: Full redacted browser report downloaded locally via Blob after suite completion. Original job19 baseline retained in live-before-job19.json.
